text: Lahore Metrobus (Metro) is operated by Punjab Mass Transit Authority (PMA), Govt. of Punjab. Dedicated BRT corridor, Shahdara to Gajju Matta, 27 stations. Metro's feeder network is operated as the Speedo routes below (same buses; PMA's internal name is 'Feeder Route N', public brand is 'Speedo'). Fare: Rs 30 (Flat (token/card)). Operating hours: 06:15 to 22:00, Daily (incl. Sundays & holidays).

metadata.operator: Punjab Mass Transit Authority (PMA), Govt. of Punjab

text: Speedo Bus Service (PMA Feeder Routes) (Speedo) is operated by Punjab Mass Transit Authority (PMA), Govt. of Punjab. 34 routes currently operating (Phase I+II). PMA's long-term plan includes Phase III-VIII (routes 35-122) -- NOT YET operational, excluded from this dataset. Metro Card is valid on all Speedo routes. Fare: Rs 20 to Rs 80 (Distance-based). Operating hours: 06:00 to 22:00, Daily (incl. holidays).

text: Electro (Punjab Electric Bus Service) (Electro) is operated by Punjab Transport Company (PTC), Transport Department, Govt. of Punjab. GPS tracking, WiFi, USB ports, ramps; 250km range per charge; charging depot at Green Town/Hamdard Chowk. Phase-II routes (Raiwind-Thokar Niaz Baig, Thokar Niaz Baig-Harbanspura) launched but intermediate stops not yet published as of Sep 2026. Fare: Rs 20 (Flat). Operating hours: 06:00 to 22:00, Daily.
